verses.text_urhobo: Asakiephana akpọ na ejobi kẹ ephẹrẹ ọvo kugbe emeta tutuno.
verses.text_romanized: asakiephana akpo na ejobi ke ephere ovo kugbe emeta tutuno

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ihwo vwọ kua nẹ abọ rẹ ọnre da vacha re, ayen da rhe mrẹ uphephe ọvo vwẹ otọ ri Shinar ayen da dia Etiyin.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ihwo vwo kua ne abo re onre da vacha re ayen da rhe mre uphephe ovo vwe oto ri shinar ayen da dia etiyin

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen da ta kẹ ohwohwo, Yanrhe, e jẹn avwanre ma ikori ekpẹn, re anabọ torhẹ ayen. Ayen da vwẹ ikori ekpẹn na vwo ru elalọ, orhọnrhe kọye e vwọ gbe.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da ta ke ohwohwo yanrhe e jen avwanre ma ikori ekpen re anabo torhe ayen ayen da vwe ikori ekpen na vwo ru elalo orhonrhe koye e vwo gbe

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen da rha ta, Yanrhe, e jẹn avwanre bọn orere kẹ oma rẹ avwanre, ra bọn uwevwi rẹ enu phihọ ro kpenu odjuvwu, re avwanre re odẹ kẹ oma rẹ avwanre, ọ rha dia eriyin avwanre ke cha hra vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da rha ta yanrhe e jen avwanre bon orere ke oma re avwanre ra bon uwevwi re enu phiho ro kpenu odjuvwu re avwanre re ode ke oma re avwanre o rha dia eriyin avwanre ke cha hra vwe enu re akpo na ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo de wotọ rhe mrẹ orere na kugbe uwevwi rẹ enu na, rẹ emọ rẹ ihwo rẹ akpọ bọnre na.
verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo de woto rhe mre orere na kugbe uwevwi re enu na re emo re ihwo re akpo bonre na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo da ta, Nighe, ayen ohwo ọvo, ayen ki rhe vwo ephẹrẹ ọvo, Ọnana kẹ ẹtuọhọ rẹ emu rẹ ayen che ru: o gbi vwo emu ọvuọvo rẹ ayen guọnọ ru rọ cha bẹn ayen eruo-o.
verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da ta nighe ayen ohwo ovo ayen ki rhe vwo ephere ovo onana ke etuoho re emu re ayen che ru o gbi vwo emu ovuovo re ayen guono ru ro cha ben ayen eruo o

verses.text_urhobo: Gba yanrhe, re wotọ rhe, ra dia Etiyin phi ozighi phihọ ephẹrẹ rayen, rere ayen jẹn ephẹrẹ rẹ ohwo ohwo enyo.
verses.text_romanized: gba yanrhe re woto rhe ra dia etiyin phi ozighi phiho ephere rayen rere ayen jen ephere re ohwo ohwo enyo

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Ọrovwohwo da hra ayen nene enu rẹ akpọ na ejobi, ayen gbe bọn orere na ọfa-a.
verses.text_romanized: koye orovwohwo da hra ayen nene enu re akpo na ejobi ayen gbe bon orere na ofa a

verses.text_urhobo: Fiki rẹ ọtiọye na e de se odẹ rọye Babẹl, fikiridie Etiyin Ọrovwohwo de zighi ephẹrẹ rẹ akpọ na ejobi, kẹ Etiyin rhe Ọrovwohwo da hra ayen nene enu rẹ akpọ na ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: fiki re otioye na e de se ode roye babel fikiridie etiyin orovwohwo de zighi ephere re akpo na ejobi ke etiyin rhe orovwohwo da hra ayen nene enu re akpo na ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Enana keye uvwiẹ ri Shẹm. Ọke ri Shẹm vwọ ghwo te ẹgbukpe ujori re, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Arpakshad, ikpe ivẹ rẹ oghwe na vwọ kpọnu;
verses.text_romanized: enana keye uvwie ri shem oke ri shem vwo ghwo te egbukpe ujori re o da rhe dia ose ri arpakshad ikpe ive re oghwe na vwo kponu

verses.text_urhobo: Shẹm ke rha rhe dia ro vwo vwiẹ Arpakshad nu ikpe uri ivẹ gbẹ ujori, o de vwiẹ emeshare vẹ emetẹ.
verses.text_romanized: shem ke rha rhe dia ro vwo vwie arpakshad nu ikpe uri ive gbe ujori o de vwie emeshare ve emete

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Arpakshad vwọ dia ikpe ọgban gbẹ iyori re ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Shelah;
verses.text_romanized: oke re arpakshad vwo dia ikpe ogban gbe iyori re o da rhe dia ose ri shelah

verses.text_urhobo: Arpakshad vwo vwiẹ Shelah nu ọ da dia ikpe uri ivẹ gbẹ erha, o de rhe vwiẹ emeshare vẹ emetẹ.
verses.text_romanized: arpakshad vwo vwie shelah nu o da dia ikpe uri ive gbe erha o de rhe vwie emeshare ve emete

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Shelah vwọ dia ikpe ọgban re, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ rẹ Eber;
verses.text_romanized: ri shelah vwo dia ikpe ogban re o da rhe dia ose re eber

verses.text_urhobo: ri Shelah vwo vwiẹ Eber nu, ọ da dia ikpe uri ivẹ gbẹ erha, o de vwiẹ emeshare vẹ emetẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ri shelah vwo vwie eber nu o da dia ikpe uri ive gbe erha o de vwie emeshare ve emete

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ Eber vwọ dia ikpe ọgban gbẹ ẹne re, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Pẹlẹg,
verses.text_romanized: re eber vwo dia ikpe ogban gbe ene re o da rhe dia ose ri peleg

verses.text_urhobo: rẹ Eber vwo vwiẹ Pẹlẹg nu ọ da dia ikpe uri ivẹ gbẹ ọgban, o de vwiẹ emeshare vẹ emetẹ.
verses.text_romanized: re eber vwo vwie peleg nu o da dia ikpe uri ive gbe ogban o de vwie emeshare ve emete

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Pẹlẹg vwọ dia ikpe ọgban re, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Reu;
verses.text_romanized: ri peleg vwo dia ikpe ogban re o da rhe dia ose ri reu

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Pẹlẹg vwo vwiẹ Reu nu ọ da dia ikpe uri gbẹ irhiri, o de vwiẹ emeshare vẹ emetẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ri peleg vwo vwie reu nu o da dia ikpe uri gbe irhiri o de vwie emeshare ve emete

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Reu vwọ dia ikpe ọgban gbẹ ivẹ re, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Serug,
verses.text_romanized: ri reu vwo dia ikpe ogban gbe ive re o da rhe dia ose ri serug

verses.text_urhobo: ri Reu vwo vwiẹ Serug nu ọ da dia ikpe uri gbẹ ighwrẹ, o de vwiẹ emeshare vẹ emetẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ri reu vwo vwie serug nu o da dia ikpe uri gbe ighwre o de vwie emeshare ve emete

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Serug vwọ dia ikpe ọgban re, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Nahọr,
verses.text_romanized: ri serug vwo dia ikpe ogban re o da rhe dia ose ri nahor

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Serug vwo vwiẹ Nahọr nu, ọ da dia ikpe uri, ọ de vwiẹ emeshare vẹ emetẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ri serug vwo vwie nahor nu o da dia ikpe uri o de vwie emeshare ve emete

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ri Nahọr vwọ dia ikpe uje gbẹ irhiri re, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Terah;
verses.text_romanized: oke ri nahor vwo dia ikpe uje gbe irhiri re o da rhe dia ose ri terah

verses.text_urhobo: ri Nahọr vwo vwiẹ Terah nu ọ da dia ikpe ujori gbẹ ihwe gbẹ irhiri, o de vwiẹ emeshare vẹ emetẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ri nahor vwo vwie terah nu o da dia ikpe ujori gbe ihwe gbe irhiri o de vwie emeshare ve emete

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Terah vwọ dia ikpe ujorha gbẹ ihwe re, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ rẹ Ebram, Nahọr, kugbe Haran.
verses.text_romanized: ri terah vwo dia ikpe ujorha gbe ihwe re o da rhe dia ose re ebram nahor kugbe haran

verses.text_urhobo: Enana keye uvwiẹ ri Terah. Terah ọye ọsẹ rẹ Ebram, Nahọr kugbe Haran; Haran kọye ọsẹ ri Lọt.
verses.text_romanized: enana keye uvwie ri terah terah oye ose re ebram nahor kugbe haran haran koye ose ri lot

verses.text_urhobo: Haran da karo rẹ ọsẹ rọye ghwu vwẹ otọ re de vwiẹ, vwi Ur ri Kaldia.
verses.text_romanized: haran da karo re ose roye ghwu vwe oto re de vwie vwi ur ri kaldia

verses.text_urhobo: Ebram vi Nahọr da reyọ eya, odẹ rẹ aye rẹ Ebram ki Serai, odẹ re aye ri Nahọr ki Milka, ọmọtẹ ri Haran ọsẹ ri Milka vẹ Iska.
verses.text_romanized: ebram vi nahor da reyo eya ode re aye re ebram ki serai ode re aye ri nahor ki milka omote ri haran ose ri milka ve iska

verses.text_urhobo: Serai kẹ ẹga, o vwiẹ ọmọ-ọ.
verses.text_romanized: serai ke ega o vwie omo o

verses.text_urhobo: Terah da reyọ Ebram rẹ ọmọ rọye vi Lọt rẹ ọmọ ri Haran, rẹ ovwrọmọ rọye, vi Serai rẹ aye rẹ ọmọ rọye Ebram, ayen ejobi de ku usun phihọ ni Ur ri Kaldia vwo kpo Kenan, ẹkẹvuọvo rẹ ayen vwo te Haran ayen da daji Etiyin.
verses.text_romanized: terah da reyo ebram re omo roye vi lot re omo ri haran re ovwromo roye vi serai re aye re omo roye ebram ayen ejobi de ku usun phiho ni ur ri kaldia vwo kpo kenan ekevuovo re ayen vwo te haran ayen da daji etiyin

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ ri Terah ejobi da dia ikpe uri gbe iyori, Terah de ghwu vwi Haran.
verses.text_romanized: ede re akpo ri terah ejobi da dia ikpe uri gbe iyori terah de ghwu vwi haran
